welcome.title: Boot Repair Assistant
welcome.subtitle: Guided assistant for analysis, validation, planning and explicit boot repair execution on Linux.
welcome.message: The workflow is controlled and does not repair automatically. You must review the analysis, confirm the target, and then approve the plan before execution.
welcome.progress: Initial flow ready to start detection.
help.title: Quick help
help.subtitle: Light summary of the workflow and how to use the app without external documentation.
help.section.what.text: Detects disks, analyzes the system, and generates a boot repair plan. It does not change anything without your approval.
help.section.start.text: Click Start, wait for disk and partition detection, and choose the root partition before continuing.
help.section.choose: How to choose disk and partition
help.section.choose.text: Select the root system and, on UEFI, a matching EFI partition. The disk is shown only for context.
help.section.sudo: When to use sudo or live USB
help.section.sudo.text: Use sudo when the app requests disk access. Run from live USB if the main system fails to boot.
help.section.read: How to read diagnostics and plan
help.section.read.text: Read the diagnostic details and validate the plan before approving execution.
help.section.assisted: This app is assisted, not automatic
help.section.assisted.text: Boot Repair proposes actions and requires your approval at every step. It does not repair automatically.
help.steps.title: Mini step-by-step flow
help.steps.step1: Detect: click Start to collect disks and partitions.
help.steps.step2: Analyze: review the evidence before advancing.
help.steps.step3: Plan: confirm the generated plan and its risks.
help.steps.step4: Execute: run only after reviewing everything.
execution.ready_message: Plan approved. Wait for final confirmation to execute.

risk.wrong_target.description: Wrong target device can make the system unbootable
risk.wrong_target.mitigation: Confirm the selected root partition before execution
risk.mount_failure.description: Filesystem mounts can fail if the target is already mounted
risk.mount_failure.mitigation: Review mount points in the analysis stage before planning
risk.uefi_requires_esp.description: UEFI repair requires a valid EFI System Partition
risk.uefi_requires_esp.mitigation: Verify that the EFI partition is selected and belongs to a valid ESP target
risk.cross_disk_uefi.description: EFI and root partitions are on different disks
risk.cross_disk_uefi.mitigation: Confirm cross-disk UEFI boot topology before proceeding
risk.not_live_environment.description: Repairs outside a live environment are less reliable
risk.not_live_environment.mitigation: Prefer a live boot environment for the operation
risk.detected_initramfs_tool.mitigation: The repair plan includes regeneration if the tool exists in the target environment
risk.arch_family.mitigation: Arch and Arch-based systems may use mkinitcpio, bootctl, or grub-mkconfig
risk.debian_family.mitigation: Debian-family systems may use update-initramfs and update-grub
justification.mount_confirmation: The plan only mounts the selected target after explicit confirmation
justification.chroot_bootloader: Bootloader repair is executed inside a chroot with explicit commands
justification.initramfs_regeneration: Initramfs regeneration is included when available to maintain boot consistency
